about: 2026-11-02 story upgrade phase 9: qa/stories_test/010_triggers.json as STEVE AUSTIN: each ending a script can set (tko, dq, count-out for the opponent, submission; the shots: the game's own result banner, replay, results line, and the branch's page says OK), then each condition (health, outside, a hold, a finisher: the fired bit says which trigger, the 'time' fallback is the last bit), the rule changes (the state's top bits: DQ on, count-out on), a run-in held till its trigger at 0:20. A fired trigger's bit in rr_kept_out

expect.name: outside: its own trigger fired (bit 0 or 1)
hold: its trigger or the time fallback fired (the CPU may not take a hold in 4:00; 2026-11-02_091857 saw it fire)
finisher: its own trigger fired (bit 0 or 1)
rules: DQ on at the start
expect.check: matches >= 10900 and matches < 11000 and mode == -2 and match_frames > 100 and (rr_kept_out & 1) == 0 and (rr_kept_out & 0x4000) != 0

expect.name: rules: no DQ, no count-out after their triggers
expect.check: matches >= 10900 and matches < 11000 and mode == -2 and (rr_kept_out & 3) == 3 and (rr_kept_out & 0xC000) == 0

expect.name: late run-in: its trigger fired (the man himself: the shots; slots past the match's two aren't in the state)
